metric_contract.sacrebleu: macro mean of sentence BLEU, tokenize=none, scale 0-100
metric_contract.chrf: macro mean of sentence chrF, sacrebleu default configuration, scale 0-100
metric_contract.chrf_pp: macro mean of sentence chrF++, word_order=2, scale 0-100
metric_contract.character_error_rate: mean normalized Levenshtein over NFC/casefold characters
metric_contract.word_error_rate: mean normalized Levenshtein over NFC/casefold whitespace tokens
metric_contract.map_at_5: binary relevance, retrieved top-5, AP denominator min(5, known relevant)

embedding_cosine_similarity.contract: L2-normalized sentence embeddings, dot product, macro mean

meteor.contract: vi-normalized-exact METEOR, identity stemmer, no synonyms, nltk defaults
